NONE: › 1,000,000,000,000,000,000 times the stated unit
（計量單位）艾

example: an exabyte
艾位元組

NONE: › to make something that is already bad even worse
使惡化；使加重；使加劇

example: This attack will exacerbate the already tense relations between the two communities.
這次襲擊將令兩個原本已經處於緊張狀態的團體關係更加惡化。

NONE: B1 in great detail, or complete, correct, or true in every way
精確的；確切的；正確的
› to demand and get something, sometimes using force or threats
勒索；強要
› to make something necessary
迫切需要

example: The exact distance is 1.838 metres.
精確距離是1.838公尺。
The exact time of the accident was 2.43 p.m.
事件發生的正確時間是下午兩點四十三分。
"I still owe you £7, don't I?" "Actually, it's £7.30 to be exact."
「我還欠你七英鎊，是不是？」「實際上，準確地說應該是7.3英鎊。」
The exact location of the factory has yet to be decided.
這間工廠的準確位置還未定案。
Unlike astronomy, astrology cannot be described as an exact science.
占星術與天文學不同，嚴格來講，占星術不能稱為一門科學。
to exact revenge on someone
向某人報復
The blackmailers exacted a total of $100,000 from their victims.
勒索人從幾名受害人那裡總共勒索了十萬美元。
Heart surgery exacts tremendous skill and concentration.
心臟外科手術要求施術者技術高超且精神要高度集中。

NONE: › demanding a lot of effort, care, or attention
需付出極大努力的；要求小心仔細的；要求嚴格的

example: an exacting training schedule
安排緊張的訓練進度表

NONE: A2 used when you are giving or asking for information that is completely correct
精確地；確切地；完全準確地
B1 used to emphasize what you are saying
（用於強調）正好，恰好；究竟
› used for saying that someone or something is slightly different from a particular way of describing him, her, or it
算不上…，並非十分…
B2 used for saying that something is not completely true
並不完全是這樣
› used for saying that something is the opposite of a particular way of describing it
並非…

example: The journey took exactly three hours.
剛好是三個小時的路程。
That'll be £15 exactly, please.
剛好15英鎊，請付錢。
It tastes exactly the same as the real thing, but has half the fat.
它和真品的味道完全一樣，但脂肪含量卻只有一半。
"What you seem to be saying is that more should be invested in the road system and less in the railways." "Exactly" (= that is correct).
「你的意思好像是說應該在公路系統上多投資，而在鐵路系統上少投資。」「完全正確。 」
Do exactly what I tell you and no one will get hurt!
確實照我講的去做，就不會有人受傷！
Exactly how do you propose to achieve this?
你究竟打算怎樣做到這件事？
What exactly do you mean?
你究竟是甚麼意思？
He's not exactly good-looking, but he has a certain attraction.
他不算英俊，但有一種魅力。
"So you gave her your iPod?" "Not exactly, I lent it to her."
「那你把你的iPod給她了？」「也不是，我只是借給她。」
Answer the question - it's not exactly difficult.
回答這個問題——這個問題並不難啊。

NONE: C1 to make something seem larger, more important, better, or worse than it really is
誇張；誇大；對…言過其實

example: The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.
遭受襲擊的威脅被過分誇大了。
Don't exaggerate - it wasn't that expensive.
不要言過其實——沒有那麼貴。
I'm not exaggerating - it was the worst meal I've ever eaten in my life.
我不是在誇大其詞——那是我這輩子吃過最難吃的飯。

NONE: C1 the fact of making something seem larger, more important, better, or worse than it really is
誇張；誇大；言過其實

example: Sal estimates over 60 people were there but I think that's a slight exaggeration.
薩爾估計那邊有60幾人，但我覺得有點誇張。
[ + to infinitive ] It would be no exaggeration to say that her work has saved lives.
她的工作挽救了很多生命，這樣說一點也不誇張。

NONE: › formal to raise someone to a higher rank or more powerful position
晉升；提拔
› old use to praise someone a lot
頌揚；高度讚揚

U: › formal a very strong feeling of happiness
› formal the act of raising someone to a higher rank or more powerful position

NONE: › An exalted position in an organization is a very important one.
重要的，顯赫的（地位）
› formal extremely happy
興高采烈的

example: She rose to the exalted post of Foreign Secretary.
她升到了外交部長這個顯赫的位置。

NONE: A2 a test of a student's knowledge or skill in a particular subject
考試

example: American students ranked fourth in those taking the geography exam.
美國學生在參加地理考試的學生中名列第四。
I failed my physics exam, but I passed chemistry.
我物理考試不及格，但化學考試及格了。
an examination paper
試卷

C or U: B2 [ C or U ] the act of looking at or considering something carefully in order to discover something

example: a post-mortem examination
驗屍
I had to have/undergo a medical examination when I joined the pension scheme.
在加入養老金計劃之前，我不得不進行了一次體檢。
The evidence is still under examination (= being examined).
仍然在對那些證據進行調查。
I thought it was paint at first, but on closer examination I realized it was dried blood.
一開始我以為是油漆，但仔細一看，才意識到那是乾掉的血跡。

T: B2 to look at or consider a person or thing carefully and in detail in order to discover something about them.
C2 to test someone's knowledge or skill in a particular subject

example: Forensic scientists are examining the wreckage for clues about the cause of the explosion.
法醫科學家正在對殘骸進行檢查，希望能發現與爆炸原因有關的線索。
The council is to examine ways of reducing traffic in the city centre.
市政委員會將研究減少市中心交通流量的方法。
The research examined the effects of alcohol on long-term memory.
這項研究探討了酒精對長期記憶的影響。
[ + question word ] We need to examine how an accident like this can be avoided in the future.
我們需要研究將來如何能避免類似事故再次發生。
A psychiatrist was examined (= asked questions) on the mental state of the defendant.
一位精神病專家接受了提問，就被告的精神狀況回答了一些問題。
We were examined on European history.
我們參加了歐洲史考試。
UK You'll be examined in three main areas; speaking, listening, and reading comprehension.
將從三個主要方面對你們進行測試，即口語、聽力和閱讀理解。

NONE: B1 someone whose job is to decide how well someone has done in an examination
主考人；考官

example: The candidates listed below have failed to satisfy the examiners.
考官認為，下列考生沒有達到要求。

C: A1 something that is typical of the group of things that it is a member of
A1 a way of helping someone to understand something by showing them how it is used
A1 used when giving an example of the type of thing you mean
B2 a person or a way of behaving that is considered suitable to be copied
› a punishment that is intended to warn others against doing the thing that is being punished, or a person who receives such a punishment

example: Could you give me an example of the improvements you have mentioned?
你可不可以舉個例子說明一下你剛剛提到的那些進展情況？
This painting is a marvellous example of her work.
這幅畫是她非常出色的代表作。

exemplify
Study the examples first of all, then attempt the exercises on the next page.
首先仔細研究一下例題，然後試做下一頁的練習題。
Offices can easily become more environmentally-friendly by, for example, using recycled paper.
舉手之勞就可以使辦公室更加環保，例如，使用再生紙。
He's a very good example to the rest of the class.
他是班上其他同學的好榜樣。
He's decided to follow the example of his father and study law.
他決定效法他的父親，學習法律。
The judge made an example of him and gave him the maximum possible sentence.
為了以儆效尤，法官在法律許可的範圍內對他作出了最重的判決。

NONE: › to make someone very annoyed, usually when they can do nothing to solve a problem
激怒，使氣惱，使煩惱（通常使人束手無策）
› annoyed, especially because you can do nothing to solve a problem
被激怒的；惱怒的；極厭煩的

example: He's becoming increasingly exasperated with the situation.
面對這種情形，他越來越惱怒。

NONE: › annoying, especially because you can do nothing to solve a problem
使人惱怒的；激怒人的

example: It's so exasperating when he won't listen to a word that I say.
我說甚麼他都不聽，真使人生氣。

NONE: › the feeling of being annoyed, especially because you can do nothing to solve a problem
惱怒，憤怒；激怒

example: There is growing exasperation within the government at the failure of these policies to reduce unemployment.
由於這些減少失業的政策不能產生效用，政府內部越來越多人感到懊惱。
After ten hours of fruitless negotiations, he stormed out of the meeting in exasperation.
經過十個小時徒勞無功的漫長談判，他憤然衝出會場。
